picks.headline: Foundry's SmartRoto: AI-assisted roto that aims to work the way you do
picks.rationale: Highest actionability in the pool: it automates the single most labour-heavy manual task in the VFX pipeline (rotoscoping) inside Nuke while leaving the spline under artist control — a compositor's Monday changes because of this.
picks.excerpt: Foundry released SmartRoto, an AI-powered Nuke plugin that accelerates rotoscoping by automating keyframe animation while preserving artist control and precision at image edges. It targets the single most labour-heavy manual task in the VFX pipeline without taking the spline away from the artist.

picks.headline: Great ways to use Auto Mask in Final Cut Pro
picks.rationale: Practical, hands-on ML masking inside an NLE — per-frame recognition of people, body parts and pets with no tracking, replacing manual roto for selective grading and VFX right in the timeline.
picks.excerpt: Auto Mask in Final Cut Pro 12.3 recognizes people, body parts, scene elements and even pets on every frame with no tracking required, opening up fast selective color correction and VFX work. A practical look at ML-driven masking replacing manual roto inside an NLE.

picks.headline: Foundry Launches Griptape Enterprise for Secure AI-Accelerated VFX Workflows
picks.rationale: The governance half of the AI-in-VFX story: studio-controlled licensing plus on-prem/private-cloud options decide which AI models artists may actually use and whether IP stays in the facility.
picks.excerpt: New tier adds studio-controlled licensing, project management and governance tools for high-end media production, giving pipeline supervisors control over which AI models artists use. Studios can run workflows on-premises or in private cloud to keep sensitive IP, prompts and training data inside the facility.

picks.headline: 'This Is a Black-and-White Issue': Jorge R. Gutierrez Says Death Threats Drove Decision to Axe His GenAI Animated Project at Amazon
picks.rationale: The sharpest read this cycle on the social ceiling for genAI-native animation — a named director walking away from a major studio initiative marks the real limit of the creative community's tolerance.
picks.excerpt: Director Jorge R. Gutierrez explains why he walked away from Amazon MGM's generative-AI animation initiative, describing the backlash and threats that followed the announcement. A stark read on how far the creative community's tolerance for genAI-native animation production actually extends.

picks.headline: Latest Dalet Flex LTS Boosts AI Workflows, Deepens Dalia Integration
picks.rationale: Covers the AI shift further up the media supply chain — intelligent automation from acquisition through delivery, the layer most artist-facing tool coverage skips.
picks.excerpt: Dalet's latest Long-Term Supported release of Dalet Flex introduces intelligent automation across the media production lifecycle, expanding AI-powered capabilities through deeper Dalia integration to streamline workflows from content acquisition through delivery.
